title: AARO sends ODNI a false MFR

tellings.quote: When I went to ODNI September 10th of 2025, Kloski was director per ODNI digs

plain: Dylan Borland says that between 2023 and 2025, the Pentagon office that handles reports of unexplained objects in the sky, called AARO, sent a false memorandum for record (a written note made for the official file) to the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, the body that oversees all US spy agencies. Borland tells it as someone who took part. He says that when he went to that office on September 10, 2025, a man named Jon Kosloski was AARO's director, and that if his account is true, the office meant to look into these questions was putting false things on paper.
